title: Introduce structured sampling_profile and deprecate legacy temperature/top_p request fields
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Summary: We will introduce a structured request parameter sampling_profile that consolidates sampling controls (temperature, top_p, top_k, typical_p, repetition_penalty, token_biases) into a single, versioned object. The legacy scalar fields temperature and top_p (and the rarely-used top_k/typical_p tokens when sent at top-level) will be deprecated. Rationale: customers increasingly need repeatable, testable sampling presets and the ability to attach metadata and named profiles to requests. A structured sampling_profile enables: 1) named, reusable presets; 2) deterministic policy evolution and versioning; 3) clearer telemetry and A/Bing of sampling policies; 4) SDK ergonomics for presets and validation. Scope: - Server: accept sampling_profile v1 in the unified generate/chat endpoints and shadow-evaluate when legacy fields present. - SDKs: add helpers to create sampling profiles and surface migration warnings. - Console: add Sampling Profiles UI and preset library. - Telemetry: alarm/monitoring for legacy field usage and quality regressions.
non_goals: Immediate removal of server-side legacy parsing (we will deprecate + warn, then remove after gates)
Automatic rewriting of arbitrary client logic that sets sampling parameters in application code (we will supply mapping rules and client helpers)
Model-level changes to sampling algorithms; this work is purely API/UX and telemetry
acceptance_criteria: API accepts sampling_profile v1 with documented schema and returns 200 for valid requests
Server emits deprecation-warning header X-RW-Deprecation: sampling-legacy-fields in responses when legacy top-level sampling fields were present
SDKs (Python, Node, Go) include sampling_profile builders and surface a runtime warning when legacy fields are used
A migration guide + examples exist in docs with mapping rules and common presets
Telemetry shows migration progress: legacy-field usage down to <5% of traffic before full removal gate
Quality regression gates defined and automated evals run against canonical prompt set to detect sampling-induced distribution shifts
Console UI shows Sampling Profiles list and allows creating a profile that maps to sampling_profile v1
migration_steps: Design: finalize sampling_profile v1 schema (fields: mode, temperature, top_p, top_k, typical_p, repetition_penalty, token_biases, preset_id) and validation rules
Server: implement parsing for sampling_profile and shadow-apply legacy->profile mapping (no removal) -- emit telemetry for legacy usage
SDKs: add helpers for constructing sampling_profile and add deprecation warnings when legacy fields used; include examples for mapping common configs
Docs: publish migration guide with mapping rules, common presets (chatty, concise, safe, deterministic), and code snippets
Console: add UI to create named Sampling Profiles and attach to routes/models
Pilot: opt-in shadow rollout for 10% of traffic with server-side shadow-evaluation to compare outputs between legacy and sampling_profile semantics
Telemetry gate: require legacy usage <20% and no quality regression for 48h in pilot before expanding rollout
Progressive rollout: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% of surface area accepting explicit sampling_profile (legacy still accepted until final removal)
Deprecation notice: send email + dashboard banners to customers 90/60/30 days before planned removal of legacy parsing
Final removal: after telemetry gates and announced window, remove legacy parsing and return 400 when legacy-only fields are present; provide clear migration error message
rollout_plan: Q2 2026 Week 1: RFC and schema freeze
Q2 2026 Week 3-5: Server + SDK implementation; internal dogfooding
Q2 2026 Week 6: Pilot opt-in shadow rollout (10%)
Q2 2026 Week 8-10: Expand pilot according to telemetry gates
Q3 2026 Week 1: Public deprecation notices (90 days to removal window)
Q3 2026 Week 12: Final removal target if telemetry AND adoption gates satisfied
telemetry_gates: Legacy-field usage fraction: current baseline and target thresholds (20% for expansion, <5% for final removal)
Error rate: no statistically significant increase in 95th percentile latency or user-facing 500 errors post rollout
Quality: automated eval harness comparing legacy semantics vs sampling_profile outputs on canonical prompt suite; acceptable drift <1.5% on key metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/custom similarity as applicable)
Customer support signal: no >5 high-severity tickets attributable to sampling changes during each expansion window
SDK adoption: >= 80% of newly created SDK calls use sampling_profile in sample of instrumented repos after 2 months
notes: Mapping guidance: when temperature is provided without top_p, sampling_profile.mode="temperature-only" and top_p left null; when both provided, map both. For unrecognized combos, default to conservative preset 'balanced'
We will expose preset_id to allow referencing organization-level Sampling Profiles from the client; backend will resolve preset_id to full sampling_profile at request-time
Because sampling parameters interact with model beam/decoding internals, we will coordinate with Research to define the canonical canonical eval metrics to use for quality gates
SDK maintainers should add one-line migration recipes in CHANGELOG for each release that includes helper functions
